questions.question: Which city is home to the Burj Khalifa?
questions.question_speech: Question one. Which city is home to the Burj Khalifa? A. Doha. B. Cairo. C. Riyadh. D. Dubai.
questions.answer_speech: Option D is correct. Dubai. Burj Khalifa in Dubai is the world's tallest structure, standing eight hundred twenty-eight meters tall.
questions.reveal: Burj Khalifa in Dubai is the world's tallest structure, standing 828 m tall.
questions.source_keyword: the world's tallest structure ... of 828 m (2,717 ft)

questions.question: The ancient rose-red city of Petra is in which country?
questions.question_speech: Question two. The ancient rose-red city of Petra is in which country? A. Syria. B. Turkey. C. Jordan. D. Lebanon.
questions.answer_speech: Option C is correct. Jordan. Petra in Jordan is famous for its rock-cut architecture and is called the Rose City.
questions.reveal: Petra in Jordan is famous for its rock-cut architecture and is called the Rose City.
questions.source_keyword: famous for its rock-cut architecture ... also called the Rose City

questions.question: Angkor Wat is a famous temple complex in which country?
questions.question_speech: Question three. Angkor Wat is a famous temple complex in which country? A. Cambodia. B. Vietnam. C. Laos. D. Thailand.
questions.answer_speech: Option A is correct. Cambodia. Angkor Wat in Cambodia was built in the twelfth century as a Hindu temple dedicated to Vishnu.
questions.reveal: Angkor Wat in Cambodia was built in the 12th century as a Hindu temple dedicated to Vishnu.
questions.source_keyword: constructed between 1113 and 1150 CE ... as a Hindu temple dedicated to Vishnu

questions.question: The Leaning Tower of Pisa is in which country?
questions.question_speech: Question four. The Leaning Tower of Pisa is in which country? A. Portugal. B. Greece. C. Spain. D. Italy.
questions.answer_speech: Option D is correct. Italy. The Leaning Tower of Pisa, in Italy, is the bell tower of Pisa Cathedral, leaning nearly four degrees.
questions.reveal: The Leaning Tower of Pisa, Italy, is the bell tower of Pisa Cathedral, leaning nearly four degrees.
questions.source_keyword: campanile, or freestanding bell tower, of Pisa Cathedral; nearly four-degree lean

questions.question: Mount Rushmore, with four carved presidents, is in which US state?
questions.question_speech: Question five. Mount Rushmore, with four carved presidents, is in which US state? A. Montana. B. South Dakota. C. Wyoming. D. Colorado.
questions.answer_speech: Option B is correct. South Dakota. Mount Rushmore in South Dakota shows the heads of Washington, Jefferson, Roosevelt and Lincoln.
questions.reveal: Mount Rushmore in South Dakota shows the heads of Washington, Jefferson, Roosevelt and Lincoln.
questions.source_keyword: colossal sculpture ... heads of Washington, Jefferson, Roosevelt, Lincoln
